```plato

//==
// # Bounding volume hierarchies and region trees
//
// Pure-data hierarchical indexes over collections of primitives, plus the node
// index shared by every spatial structure in this vocabulary. Every structure
// follows the same flat-array conventions:
//
// - Nodes live in one array; a node refers to other nodes by SpatialNodeIndex
//   position in that array, with -1 meaning "no child". Node 0 is the root.
// - A structure never stores primitives; it stores a permutation array of
//   primitive indices (Array<ItemIndex>) into the caller's primitive list.
//   Leaves reference half-open IntegerInterval ranges of that permutation.
// - An empty range (Start equals End) means "no items".

// A zero-based index of a node within a spatial structure's flat node array.
// -1 means "no child" / "leaf".
type SpatialNodeIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}
```
